title: The Rainbow Bridge Adventure
description: Three friends follow a magical rainbow bridge to rescue a lost baby elephant and return it home.

scenes.description: Wide shot of lush green jungle with a shimmering rainbow bridge stretching into the sky, Aarav in foreground looking amazed.
scenes.visual_prompt: (lush green jungle:1.3), (rainbow bridge:1.4) stretching into sky, boy (Aarav:1.2) looking amazed, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), wide shot, bright colors
scenes.narration: घने जंगल में, एक चमकता इंद्रधनुषी पुल आसमान की ओर बढ़ रहा था। आरव ने आश्चर्य से ऊपर देखा।
scenes.subtitle: The Rainbow Bridge

scenes.description: Medium shot of Lila pointing at tiny baby elephant on the other side of the rainbow bridge.
scenes.visual_prompt: (girl Lila:1.3) pointing, (baby elephant:1.4) standing far on rainbow bridge, (storybook whimsical style:1.4), medium shot, clear bright sky
scenes.narration: लीला ने पुल के उस पार एक छोटे हाथी के बच्चे को देखा।
scenes.subtitle: The Lost Elephant

scenes.description: Side shot of three kids stepping onto the rainbow bridge, golden sunlight glowing through the colors.
scenes.visual_prompt: (three kids:1.3) walking on (rainbow bridge:1.4), golden sunlight passing through colors, (storybook children's illustration:1.4), side view
scenes.narration: तीनों दोस्त पुल पर कदम रखते ही, रंगों के बीच से सुनहरी धूप चमकने लगी।
scenes.subtitle: Step Onto Magic

scenes.description: Overhead view of a playful flock of parrots flying alongside the kids on the rainbow bridge.
scenes.visual_prompt: (colorful parrots:1.3) flying beside (three kids:1.2) on rainbow bridge, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), overhead view, vivid colors
scenes.narration: तोते का झुंड उनके साथ-साथ उड़ने लगा, जैसे उनका हौसला बढ़ा रहा हो।
scenes.subtitle: Flying Companions

scenes.description: Close-up of the baby elephant looking worried, standing near the end of the bridge.
scenes.visual_prompt: (baby elephant:1.4) with big eyes looking worried, standing on rainbow bridge, (storybook whimsical style:1.4), close-up, soft lighting
scenes.narration: हाथी का बच्चा डरा हुआ लग रहा था, लेकिन उसकी आँखों में उम्मीद थी।
scenes.subtitle: The Gentle Giant

scenes.description: Medium shot of kids feeding the baby elephant sweet mangoes from a basket.
scenes.visual_prompt: (three kids:1.3) feeding (baby elephant:1.4) ripe mangoes from basket, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), medium shot, happy expressions
scenes.narration: उन्होंने टोकरी से मीठे आम निकालकर हाथी को खिलाए।
scenes.subtitle: Sweet Friendship

scenes.description: Wide shot of kids and elephant walking down from the rainbow bridge into a sunny jungle clearing.
scenes.visual_prompt: (three kids:1.3) and (baby elephant:1.4) walking down rainbow bridge into sunny jungle clearing, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), wide shot
scenes.narration: वे पुल से उतरकर सूरज की रोशनी से भरे जंगल के खुले मैदान में पहुँचे।
scenes.subtitle: The Journey Home

scenes.description: Pull-back shot of happy mother elephant greeting the baby while kids wave goodbye.

scenes.narration: माँ हाथी ने अपने बच्चे को गले लगाया, और बच्चों ने मुस्कुराते हुए अलविदा कहा।
scenes.subtitle: Home at Last
